responsibility: This definition module declares Logitech-compatible bit operations specialized for a single SYSTEM.BYTE value. It owns the public interface for extracting and setting bit ranges, performing bytewise logical operators, shifts, rotates, arithmetic right shift, and nibble helpers, distinguishing it from the word-sized and block-sized bit utility modules in the same library.
same_name_distinction: This file is the definition module for the BitByteOps pair, exporting the BYTE-oriented API only; the companion BitByteOps.mod supplies the actual BYTE transformations via BITSET8, SHIFT, and ROTATE.
